trainer/30471.htm.text: Blacksmith Rupio: Nice to meet you, young traveler. I'm Rupio of the Black Anvil Guild. My younger brother Pushkin and I are trying to make this smithy as the best in Giran. Unfortunately, our tools weren't delivered until recently, so we've only just started working.

links.text: Bestow special ability on a weapon
View information about the lord and tax rate

trainer/30471-4.htm.text: Blacksmith Rupio: You can remove an armor's seal and re-seal it here. What is it that you wish done?

links.text: Release seal on B-grade gloves and boots.
Put seal back on B-grade gloves and boots.
Put seal back on A-grade armor.

trainer/30471-5.htm.text: Blacksmith Rupio: You can raise an item's performance by augmenting it. If you wish to augment an item, or remove augment, just let me know.

trainer/30471-noteach.htm.text: Blacksmith Rupio: Let me make this perfectly clear. I only teach Dwarven Fighters and Artisans. Pushkin might have the time to waste talking to you, but I am very busy and do not! Get out!

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30471-03.html.text: Blacksmith Rupio: How did you know that my hobby was relic restoration? The restoration of a stone item to its original condition requires all the pieces. If you wish for me to restore this statue of the goddess, I must have all of the pieces, the head, torso, arms and legs . Do you understand?

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30471-04.html.text: Blacksmith Rupio: Do you care to watch the master at work? First, I will attach the legs to the base... Then the torso above that... Now we match the joints of the arms and head properly... Voila! It's finished! The joints are still visible, but overall, it looks wonderful, don't you think? Hmm... …

common/augmentation_01.htm.text: Augmenting means give energy to weapons or accessories. Augmenting is simple, but it isn't always accurate. common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
